versions.description_html:
Discover what Microsoft Teams Premium actually is, how the add-on license works, intelligent meeting recaps, pricing, security features, and who needs it.

You might think Teams Premium is just Microsoft Teams with a bigger price tag. It's actually a separate add-on license that switches on features your normal Teams license leaves off.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Teams Premium Actually Is
  • Meetings That Think
  • Keeping the Meeting in the Room
  • Looking Like Your Company
  • Big Events
  • Appointments and Bookings
  • The IT Team Features
  • Who Actually Needs It
  • The Licensing Basics
  • Teams Premium or Copilot
  • Recap and a Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
